limitations: Parity fixtures measure conversion fidelity, not general decision quality.
E4B native validation covers three selected cases; browser validation covers all twelve.
Tetris is a five-piece, one-seed batch integration smoke check, not a policy benchmark.
Wall clocks in this Firefox profile were quantized; these checks do not establish a latency ranking.
No vision, audio, MoE, browser CPU loading, or prefix cache is implemented for these Gemma packs.

initialGpuProfiles.method: Three unique-state samples per case, GPU timestamp sums with profiling enabled; not decision quality or uninstrumented latency. State cache disabled.

e2b.metric: geometric mean of per-case median summed GPU kernel milliseconds

e4b.metric: geometric mean of per-case median summed GPU kernel milliseconds
